title: Famous model: M/M/1 queue (Erlang)
model_description: Poisson arrivals rate λ, exponential service rate μ. Utilization ρ=λ/μ; mean wait Wq = ρ/(μ(1-ρ)). Stable iff ρ<1.

results.reference: See scenario instances for computed runs.
